Collaborated with Standard Chartered Bank to deploy its BeeFeather Platform for intelligent risk assessment and trade finance optimization.
Partnered with over 3,500 cumulative anchor enterprises and financial institutions by the end of 2025.
The company reports that its total revenue and income for the full year of 2025 was RMB 983 million, representing a slight decrease from the RMB 1.03 billion reported in fiscal year 2024.
The company reports that its revenue and income for the first half of 2026 reached RMB 579 million, representing a 55% year-on-year increase compared to the first half of 2025.

Revenue & Growth.assessed_on: The evaluation rests on the company's publicly disclosed corporate financial results for fiscal year 2025 and interim 2026, which confirm volatile overall growth figures despite a recent mid-2026 turnaround. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed the exact breakdown of annual recurring revenue specific to its pure trade finance software and digital network services separate from its broader supply chain technology solutions portfolio.

Multi-funder Supply Chain Finance marketplace provides reverse factoring, receivables financing, and dynamic discounting.

Automated invoice synchronization engine ingests digital electronic invoices directly from enterprise ERP systems.
The platform automates data validation by providing full digital traceability of all early payments and automated clearing logs.
Real-time auction network directly connects corporate buyers and suppliers with a consortium of over 115 financial institutions.
Direct integration with major Brazilian central registrars including B3, CERC, and Núclea for trade acceptance registration.

Early adoption implementation of Banco Central do Brasil's new electronic trade acceptance model (Duplicata Escritural).
